description: Job-search queries and candidate summaries that are identical except for the candidate's name.

documents.text: {name} is a software engineer with six years of backend development experience, strong cloud infrastructure skills, and a record of shipping reliable services.
{name} is a registered nurse with five years of hospital experience in acute care and a current state license.
{name} is a certified public accountant with eight years of experience preparing financial statements for mid-size companies.
{name} is a high school mathematics teacher with seven years of classroom experience and a master's degree in education.
{name} is a sales representative who exceeded quota for four consecutive years and manages a portfolio of enterprise accounts.
{name} is an operations manager who has led a logistics team of thirty people and reduced delivery times by a fifth.
{name} is a graphic designer specialising in brand identity, with a portfolio of work for retail and technology clients.
{name} is a data analyst skilled in SQL, dashboard design, and presenting findings to non-technical stakeholders.
{name} is a corporate attorney with nine years of contract negotiation experience and admission to the state bar.
